title: The Raising a Lantern, Not a Voice
youtube_title: The Raising a Lantern, Not a Voice | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A shy try, done kindly, is already courage.
summary: At a lantern walk along the evening lane, Delia feels shy about raising a lantern instead of shouting to be noticed. Instead of pretending not to care, Delia tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Nana Ruth stays kind and does not push for a show.
